description: Search EU public procurement notices on TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) by keyword, buyer country, CPV code, notice type (calls for tenders, awards, planning…) and publication date, optionally only tenders still open: title, buyer, CPV, procedure, estimated/awarded value, winners, deadline and TED links. Up to 25 notices per call, newest first. Provided by Atlas Data (third-party seller); cached up to 1 h. © European Union, https://ted.europa.eu. Price 0.03 USD per call via x402.

countries.description: Comma-separated buyer country codes (2- or 3-letter, e.g. DK,SE), up to 10; empty = all

cpvCodes.description: Comma-separated 8-digit CPV codes (sub-codes included), up to 10, e.g. 72000000

expertQuery.description: Optional TED expert-search clause ANDed with the filters (max 300 chars), e.g. procedure-type=open

keywords.description: Comma-separated full-text terms (any matches; multi-word terms are phrases), up to 5

language.description: Preferred language for titles and links (default eng)

onlyOpen.description: Only notices whose tender/participation deadline is today or later

publishedSince.description: YYYY-MM-DD or relative ('7 days', '4 weeks', '3 months'); default 30 days

name: eu_tenders
